verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no first-party bulk or batch operation that acts on many items in one action. Headless scripting with JSON output is a developer building block a user could loop over. Parallel worktree sessions, subagents and the multi-session dashboard are adjacent orchestration features rather than a bulk-operations capability, so none of them earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
